analysis.reasonEn: RSI broke above 40 and rose to 49.1, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram improved from 867 five days ago to 4409 currently, strengthening the uptrend. Five consecutive daily closes in the green signal the start of a Higher Low pattern recovery.
